summary: Agent assisted customer with unauthorized withdrawal and secured account.

intents.keywords: I am worried my savings account shows of withdrawal...someone stealing my money.

issues.reason(s): Potential fraud, customer did not authorize the transaction.

intents.actions of agent: Confirmed transaction details, froze the account, and filed a fraud report.
intents.Process Request: Reversal of the fraudulent transaction and filing a fraud report.
intents.resolution: The agent assured the customer that the transaction will be reversed within 5 to 7 days.
